requirement: The system shall let users configure model structure and parameters through the visual front end and persist the resulting configuration data.
The system shall support preset dataset loading and configurable data-loading preparation, including preprocessing, augmentation, and dataset splitting.

The system shall execute model training according to user configuration, support manual termination during training, and evaluate and save the trained model and evaluation results when training completes.
The system shall create the inferencer workflow, initialize loaders, load a model by address, execute forward inference on the target dataset, and return results or load errors.

The system shall provide GPU-accelerated matrix computation, automatic GPU resource detection and configuration, easy-to-use GPU APIs, compatibility with the existing framework, and improved training efficiency when GPU acceleration is used.
The system shall support selectable weight initialization methods and provide integrated classic model definitions that can be created, configured, trained, and added to the NNE API.

The back end shall call the MyTorch deep learning framework and extend the existing NNE code to provide service interfaces for model initialization, training, inference, and model management to the visual system.
The system shall persist models, datasets, training logs, inference logs, and history in a local SQLite database, and provide automatic backup and automatic/manual recovery.
The front end shall provide a simple and intuitive interactive experience with training and inference visualization, real-time feedback, and guidance/help for users.
The system shall monitor training, inference, and GPU runtime exceptions, record error and performance information, apply defined fault-handling strategies, and present troubleshooting guidance.
The system shall protect user and model data with confidentiality and integrity controls and comply with relevant privacy regulations and standards.
